review_scope: JSON-only existing closed production/reference/view evidence and scalar arithmetic; not new physical or numerical qualification.
matching_rule: Same leg + original_target_index + exact d_mm; each view/reference state tied to its own production state SHA.
weak_loading_definition: Recorded loading targets 0 < d <= 0.85 mm, selected to show small absolute Fy; no contact onset threshold implied.

right2col.rejected_trial_scope: Rejected force trials retained/classified; no HP qualification or primitive arithmetic-range repair claimed.

right4col.rejected_trial_scope: Rejected force trials retained/classified; no HP qualification or primitive arithmetic-range repair claimed.

right2col.qualification: Accepted mechanical states of this explicit complete gamma1e-6 x71 side18 coarse square cycle with2mm right medium margin; no pressure, clamp, contact, auxiliary energy, stress-HP, rejected-state, all-column, H2/H3 or HF5 qualification

right4col.qualification: Accepted mechanical states of this explicit complete gamma1e-6 x71 side18 coarse square cycle with4mm right medium margin; no pressure, clamp, contact, auxiliary energy, stress-HP, rejected-state, all-column, H2/H3 or HF5 qualification

matched_conditions.source_mapping_scope: Existing preparation proves physical mapping; this review reads JSON and does not reopen model arrays.

view_scope.gap: Unsigned finite-segment tip-to-bottom distance, not contact qualification.
view_scope.Hu_J: Saved viewer medium-only fields; not assumed equal to all-domain production fields.
view_scope.force: Signed weak-form force on fixed lower-half body; 2|Fy| is magnitude sum, not mirrored net force; not pressure.

decision.reason: Peak total Fy proximity masks material/Hu cancellation; weak-loading relative Fy and horizontal force change remain material. Only one 2-to-4 mm step at fixed h=1 and fixed gamma/alpha is compared, with no declared convergence tolerance.
decision.nearest_low_cost_function_step: Build compact response from already saved JSON, expose explicit initialization/path options, then one forward API composition; no new kernel or duplicate model construction.
decision.next_physical_choice: If transferable force over the full path is required, test one further right-margin value with same h/task/ports/E/gamma/alpha/Lr/targets and match all states; do not mix uniform-E scaling or grid refinement into that margin test.
